public_six_decimal_atol.applies_to: Public box geometry rounded to six decimal places.
public_six_decimal_atol.rationale: Half of the last reported decimal place in public box lengths, angles, and reconstructed matrices.

float64_kernel_atol.rationale: Detects numerical regressions while allowing ordinary float64 propagation.

external_float32_atol.rationale: Conservative shared threshold for MDTraj and MDAnalysis agreement in the reported unit.
